title: Elux Legend Blue Razz Gummy Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend's Blue Razz Gummy Nic Salt brings the sweet and tangy taste of Blue Raspberry to life but with a chewy candy-inspired twist. The blend of bright, juicy berry notes and a sweet gummy finish makes this e-liquid a must-try for fans of playful, fruity flavours. Elux Legend Nic Salts are double-concentrated to mimic the bold, intense taste of Elux’s bestselling disposable vapes. Featuring a smooth nicotine salt formula, these e-liquids provide fast-acting nicotine relief with a gentle throat hit, delivering a satisfying and flavoursome vape experience. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Blue Razz Gummy Nic Salt is ideal for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and refillable pod kits. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid is perfect for adult smokers and vapers seeking a sweet and tangy all-day vape.
